changes: Recovered the fit observation clock from retained participant StartDate/EndDate fields in the named raw workbook and accepted handoffs. The observed sample runs 2021-09-07 through 2021-09-08; adding five calendar years gives requested_end 2026-09-08. No estimator or model terms were changed.
limitations: The paper does not report collection dates in its design/recruitment passages; dates above come from aggregate-only checks of the current local raw workbook and accepted handoffs. StartDate is the participant session start; EndDate records session completion. The analysis uses trial/round fixed effects and does not model calendar time.

The author source is a one-time online experiment, not a continuing panel or vendor series. All 343 raw submissions fall on 2021-09-07/08 and the accepted analysis condition produces 280 participants/16,800 decision rows on those dates; no post-2021-09-08 observations exist in the named source. Any new wave would require new data collection, which is outside the assigned sources.
The model record preserves a coding discrepancy: Table 2 defines DecQual as 1/0 (p. 22), while Appendix A describes ±0.5 (p. 30). This job did not recode the outcome; no extended fit was possible.

No scientific run was made because the preflight source coverage contains no observations in the requested added years; an unchanged prepared file would not constitute an extended fit. The preflight evidence is aggregate-only at work/preflight/source_coverage.json.
